notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
Optimized the Electromagnetic Trap skill: traps will now only trigger when the target touches the central area, and the preparation time has been increased to 1 second.
The initial configuration can now directly use the setup from the previous game.
Improved time display text: reduced the size of the game time text and moved it to the top-left corner to reduce visual obstruction.
Completely replaced the game models.
Added a new Skill Mode, where displacement skills can be used.
Added new displacement skills:
① Roll
② Dash
③ Long Dash
④ Channeled Flash
⑤ Out-of-Combat Speed Boost
⑥ Acceleration
⑦ Overdrive Acceleration.
These skills are available in Displacement Mode.
Fixed several game issues:
① Healing skills will no longer restore HP beyond the maximum health limit.
② Certain skills cannot be used during Stasis duration.
③ Dummies in Flash training will no longer have collision bodies.
If you encounter any issues while playing or have suggestions for the game, feel free to leave a comment in the discussion area.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
The game will now automatically configure the language based on the Steam account settings upon the first launch.
Fixed an issue that previously caused leaderboard loading errors.
Changed the number of leaderboard entries displayed to 100.
Fixed an issue where the boundaries in Flash Training mode were not causing damage correctly.
Removed obviously suspicious data from the leaderboard.

If you encounter any problems while playing or have any suggestions for the game, feel free to leave a comment in the discussion section.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Added Flash Training Mode. Come test your Flash skills!
Fixed an issue that caused some AI to stand still.
